nodes.title: Diagnosis
objectives: Calibrate STL reading, tracing, and basic complexity
completion_criteria: Explain common STL operations and trace a simple loop

nodes.title: Complexity
objectives: Relate input size to operations and extra storage
completion_criteria: Derive time/space complexity and identify the bottleneck

nodes.title: C++ Toolbox
objectives: Use core C++ containers and avoid lifetime hazards
completion_criteria: Select a fitting STL container and explain iterator/overflow risks

nodes.title: Arrays and Strings
objectives: Learn traversal, two pointers, windows, and prefix information
completion_criteria: State a loop invariant and handle empty/singleton boundaries

nodes.title: Linked List
objectives: Learn pointer rewiring, sentinels, and fast/slow pointers
completion_criteria: Draw pointer changes and handle empty/head/tail cases

nodes.title: Stack and Queue
objectives: Connect restricted order to parsing and traversal
completion_criteria: Explain why LIFO or FIFO matches the problem

nodes.title: Hash Table
objectives: Trade space for lookup, counting, and deduplication
completion_criteria: Explain the meaning of each key/value and the space cost

nodes.title: Sorting and Binary Search
objectives: Use ordering to reduce search and prove interval updates
completion_criteria: Maintain a search-interval invariant without dead loops

nodes.title: Recursion and Backtracking
objectives: Model subproblems, choice trees, undo, and pruning
completion_criteria: Define base case, state, choice, and rollback

nodes.title: Binary Tree
completion_criteria: Choose traversal order and explain returned subtree information

nodes.title: Heap and Priority Queue
objectives: Maintain only the currently most important elements
completion_criteria: Choose min-heap or max-heap for a Top-K invariant

nodes.title: BFS and DFS
objectives: Compare level expansion with path exploration
completion_criteria: Define state, neighbors, visited rule, and termination

nodes.title: Graph
objectives: Learn adjacency, connectivity, dependencies, and basic paths
completion_criteria: Choose a graph representation and traversal from edge properties

nodes.title: Greedy
objectives: Justify local choices with invariants or exchange arguments
completion_criteria: Explain why the choice cannot discard an optimum

nodes.title: Dynamic Programming
objectives: Derive state and transition from repeated recursion
completion_criteria: State semantics, transition, base values, order, and answer location
